The '''''Shadow'''''<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|315|Minak, Lett}}</ref> was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] owned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lett Minak]]. A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="Heroes" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Minak worked for rogue Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Feleea]], ferrying "special requests," which involved travel to [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] or territories controlled by renegade Moffs. Dissatisfied working for Feleea, the smuggler traveled to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and began working for Moff [[Relans]]<ref name="Heroes" /> as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. Minak continued working for Feleea aboard the ''Shadow'',<ref name="CSWE" /> but lied about his dealings in the Deep Core to avoid arousing suspicion about his regular runs to the region. He ferried Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agents]] and reports between Feleea's territory and the Deep Core. With both Moffs protecting him from inspections in their respective territories, Minak amassed wealth from the contraband he smuggled on the side.<ref name="Heroes" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Shadow'' was first mentioned in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a [[1995]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook written by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Heroes" />
